title: Dance showcase
brief: The original delivery of four cases of floor markings to studio reception has fallen through. The youth dance school needs a replacement shipment in time for the technical rehearsal. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I can book all four cases together for staffed handover at studio reception. Pickup times, guaranteed handover deadlines and all-in prices are V903 (10:12, 10:56, 99 crowns), V655 (10:21, 11:06, 94 crowns), V411 (10:17, 11:21, 68 crowns) and V631 (10:16, 11:54, 48 crowns).

Sam, when will all four cases be ready? Alex, what’s your staffed receiving window and rehearsal cutoff? Taylor, what spend is approved? I’ll book the lowest-priced service that fits.

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text: I can approve up to 102 crowns all in for all four cases traveling together. Sam, when and where can Lee collect them? Alex, what’s the earliest studio reception can accept delivery and the latest it can arrive before rehearsal? Lee, please quote a service that fits both windows, including all fees, and say how long you can hold it for approval.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
Hi all, Sam here on the supplier side. The four cases of floor markings are packed and I'm the one who releases them, so here's what I can commit to: pickup from 10:00 today at the earliest. Anything before 10:00 isn't possible on my end. The four cases have to travel together as one load, so please don't book anything that splits them.

To lock in a real booking, I need a few things from you:

Lee, what pickup slots do you have at 10:00 or later, with the transit time and quote for each?

Alex, what are the receiving hours at studio reception, and what's the latest the load can arrive and still be in time for the technical rehearsal?

Taylor, what budget ceiling are we working with, so we know which of Lee's options are approvable?

Once I have a confirmed pickup time, I'll have the goods staged and ready for the driver.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
Hi all, receiving side here. The key constraint from my end: I can guarantee someone at studio reception to sign for the load, but the latest staffed handover I can accept is 11:45. Arriving at 11:45 is fine, anything after is not. There's no unattended drop allowed, so a late arrival means the delivery fails outright.

All four cases need to come together as one load, delivered to studio reception.

To lock in a booking, I need:

- Sam: when will the four cases be ready for collection?
- Lee: which services can collect after that and get here by 11:45, and how firm is the arrival time on each?
- Taylor: what budget are we working within, so we can pick a service that fits?

Once there's an option that gets here by 11:45, I'll confirm the receiver for that slot. If a carrier needs a contact name or access details for reception, tell me and I'll supply them.

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I can reserve V411 for all four cases together. Pickup is at 10:17, with staffed handover at studio reception guaranteed by 11:21. At 68 crowns all in, it’s the cheapest service that meets the 11:45 cutoff, with 24 minutes to spare. V631 saves 20 crowns but only guarantees handover by 11:54.

Sam, please confirm release at 10:17 and the pickup point. Alex, please confirm someone can sign by 11:21. Taylor, please approve 68 crowns. I have no confirmed hold period, so please commit now or flag a specific obstacle.

[PROPOSE: V411]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
Finance lowered my limit to 75 crowns all in. Lee, I approve 68 crowns for V411. It keeps all four cases together and guarantees staffed handover by 11:21, ahead of the 11:45 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V411]

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
V411 works on my end. Pickup at 10:17 is after my 10:00 earliest release, all four cases go together as one load, and the 11:21 handover clears Alex's 11:45 cutoff at 68 crowns, well inside Taylor's 102 ceiling. I'll have the four cases staged and ready to release to the driver at 10:17 from our supplier dispatch point. Lee, please have the driver ask for me on arrival, since I'm the only one who can release the goods.

[APPROVE: V411]

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
V411 works for receiving: handover guaranteed by 11:21 is inside my 11:45 cutoff, and I'll have someone at studio reception to sign for all four cases. It also sits within Sam's 10:00 release and Taylor's 102-crown ceiling, and it's the cheapest option that does; V631's 11:54 guarantee is past my cutoff, so that one is out.

Lee, please have the driver ask for the receiving contact at studio reception. No unattended drop, so if anything slips on the day, tell me straight away.

[APPROVE: V411]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I’m requesting release of V411. Taylor approved 68 crowns all in, within the revised 75-crown limit. It’s the lowest fare that guarantees handover before 11:45.

Sam confirmed pickup of all four cases together at 10:17. The driver will ask for Sam at the supplier dispatch point, then ask for Alex’s receiving contact at studio reception for signed handover by 11:21. Alex, I’ll notify you immediately if timing slips. Sam, Alex and Taylor, please ratify the release.

[BOOK: V411]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
Lee, book V411 at 68 crowns all in. That’s within my current 75-crown limit, and Sam and Alex have confirmed pickup and signed handover for all four cases.

[APPROVE: V411]

I'm committing my release authority to V411. Pickup at 10:17 is after my 10:00 earliest release, all four cases travel together as one load, the guaranteed 11:21 handover is inside Alex's 11:45 cutoff, and 68 crowns fits Taylor's revised 75-crown limit. The cases will be staged at the supplier dispatch point for 10:17, and the driver should ask for me to release them.

[APPROVE: V411]

turns.speaker: Alex

I ratify V411 for receiving. Handover guaranteed by 11:21 is inside my 11:45 staffed cutoff, all four cases arrive together, and I'll have someone at studio reception to sign, so there's no unattended drop. Nothing has changed on my side. One correction to my earlier note: Taylor's ceiling is now 75 crowns, not 102, and 68 crowns still fits.

[APPROVE: V411]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Morning all. I have four all-in services I can book today for the four cases, each taking the full load in one go:

- V903: pickup 10:12, staffed handover guaranteed by 10:56, 99 crowns
- V655: pickup 10:21, handover by 11:06, 94 crowns
- V411: pickup 10:17, handover by 11:21, 68 crowns
- V631: pickup 10:16, handover by 11:54, 48 crowns

Pickup times are fixed, so to pick the right one I need three things:

- Sam: what's the earliest the four cases will be packed and ready at your dock?
- Alex: what's the latest handover that still works for the technical rehearsal, and is reception staffed through that window?
- Taylor: what's the budget ceiling?

Once I have those I'll tender the cheapest service that fits and confirm the booking here.

turns.speaker: Taylor

Alex, when can reception take delivery, and what’s the latest arrival that works for rehearsal? Lee, once you have those windows, please send a bookable option with pickup time, delivery time and total price so I can approve it.

turns.speaker: Sam

Hi all, Sam here on the supplier side. The four cases of floor markings are packed and I'm the one who releases them. Two firm points from my end: the earliest pickup I can commit to is 10:00, nothing before that is possible, and all four cases have to travel together on one vehicle, no splitting.

To get this booked today, here's what I need from each of you:

Lee, what collection slots do you have from 10:00 onward, what's the transit time to the studio, and what does each option cost?

Alex, what hours can reception accept delivery, and what's the latest arrival that still works for the technical rehearsal?

Taylor, what's the budget ceiling, so we know which of Lee's options we can approve?

Once we have a slot that fits the site window and the budget, I'll confirm the release for that pickup time.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: I can guarantee someone will receive all four cases together at studio reception by 11:45, including an 11:45 handover. We can’t accept an unattended drop. Sam, when will the load be ready? Lee, what service can meet that deadline, and at what price? Taylor, can you confirm the budget?

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Thanks all, that gives me everything I need. I'm tendering V411: pickup 10:17 at Sam's dock, staffed handover at studio reception guaranteed by 11:21, 68 crowns all in, with all four cases on one vehicle.

- **Why V411:** it is the cheapest service that meets every limit. Pickup is after Sam's 10:00 earliest release, handover is 24 minutes inside Alex's 11:45 deadline, and the price is 34 crowns under Taylor's 102 ceiling.
- **Why not V631:** it is cheaper at 48 crowns, but its handover guarantee is 11:54, which misses Alex's deadline.
- **Why not V903 or V655:** they arrive earlier (10:56 and 11:06) but cost 99 and 94 crowns. If anyone needs more buffer before rehearsal, say so now and I'll switch.

To lock it in, I need a commitment or a concrete objection from each of you:

- **Sam:** can you release all four cases at the dock for a 10:17 pickup?
- **Alex:** will reception be staffed to sign for the load from arrival through 11:21?
- **Taylor:** do you approve 68 crowns all in?

Once all three of you confirm, I'll book it and post the confirmation here.

[PROPOSE: V411]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
Finance lowered my limit to 75 crowns all in. I approve V411 at 68 crowns all in for all four cases together. The staffed handover by 11:21 meets the rehearsal deadline.

All three of you have approved V411, so I'm requesting the booking now: pickup 10:17 at Sam's dock, staffed handover at studio reception guaranteed by 11:21, 68 crowns all in, with all four cases on one vehicle.

V411 still fits every limit, including Taylor's lowered ceiling:
